offering_description.value: Provides cloud computing infrastructure and AI services to developers, startups and small and medium-sized businesses. Customers rent virtual servers, managed databases, storage, networking and GPU capacity through a self-service platform and API, run in the company's own data centers.

primary_products.value: virtual servers (cloud compute); managed databases; object and block storage; GPU cloud servers; managed Kubernetes

primary_services.value: cloud hosting; managed app platform; AI inference and agent platform; technical support

customer_segment.value: B2B: developers, startups, small and medium-sized businesses and digital-native enterprises

end_markets.value: software development; digital-native businesses; AI and machine learning; e-commerce; web hosting

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: pay-as-you-go hourly or monthly billing for compute, storage, bandwidth and managed services; subscription: committed monthly plans and support tiers

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates data centers and servers, selling capacity to developers and businesses; software / platform: cloud platform and API for deploying and managing applications and AI workloads

geography_served.value: global: Customers worldwide, with data centers in North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: compute, storage, databases, networking, managed platform and AI services on one cloud

distribution_channels.value: online: self-service website and API signup with credit card billing; direct sales: sales team for larger and AI customers; partners / resellers: marketplace and reseller partners

regulatory_exposure.value: low: data privacy and security rules such as GDPR and SOC compliance, no licensing requirement
